verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents function calling for Voice Agents: during a live conversation the model describes an action and its parameters, and the developer's application executes it (deepgram-docs-2, deepgram-docs-20). InjectAgentMessage can make the agent speak a specific line mid-call, which a developer could use to cover tool latency (deepgram-docs-11). missing for 10: explicit documentation of how function results are spoken back, any built-in filler or latency handling to avoid dead air during tool execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
